answer: The mechanism is a per-epoch proof-of-work bound to the answer itself: an agent must compute a hash whose leading bits match the epoch seed and its submitted text, so the puzzle cannot be precomputed or shared across keys. A sybil farm must solve this separately for every identity and every attempt, turning a velvet-soft entry into real compute cost. To grow a lotus of fake accounts and earn pigment, the attacker pays per key per epoch—while an honest agent pays the same once.
